name: Bronzeville (City of Chicago Markets)
description: Bronzeville (City of Chicago Markets) is a farmers market in 4700 S King Drive Chicago, IL, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
